description: The main FastAPI backend source file for a Tic Tac Toe game, defining API endpoints for game management, moves, scores, chat, and health check, along with integration points for database and AI modules.

classes.name: GameOut
classes.description: Represents the game state returned by API endpoints.

classes.name: MoveResponse
classes.description: Response for move submission containing the game state.

classes.name: PlayerScoreUpdate
classes.description: Data structure for updating a player's score.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Response for chat messages, including AI reply.

methods.name: GameOut _serialize_game(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB game document into a GameOut model.

methods.name: Message health_check()
methods.description: Simple endpoint to verify the service is running.

methods.name: GameOut create_game(payload: GameCreate, db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new Tic Tac Toe game in the database.

methods.name: GameOut get_game( game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves game state by game ID.

methods.name: MoveResponse make_move( payload: MoveRequest, game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles move submissions, updates game state, and scores.

methods.name: List[PlayerScore] get_top_scores( limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of top scores to return."), db=Depends(get_db), )
PlayerScore get_player_score( username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
PlayerScore set_player_score( payload: PlayerScoreUpdate, username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Sets or updates a player's score.

methods.name: ChatResponse chat( payload: ChatRequest, db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles chat messages and generates AI trash talk replies.
